# `streaming_event_watch_seconds_valid`

> Time watched since the previous event is non-negative and bounded by the content length.

| | |
|---|---|
| Domain | [streaming](README.md) |
| Layer | **silver** — evaluated by the `silver` gate |
| Model | `slv_streaming__playback_events` (`streaming_silver.slv_streaming__playback_events`) |
| Check | `expression_is_true` |
| Severity | `error` — a violation **stops the pipeline** |
| Defined in | [dbt/models/streaming/silver/_silver.yml](../../../dbt/models/streaming/silver/_silver.yml) |

## What it checks

Every row satisfies `watch_seconds between 0 and content_duration_seconds`.

## When it fails

The `silver` task of `medallion_streaming` fails, gold and `publish_gold` don't run, and the batch is never added to `streaming_gold`: consumers keep the batches published before. `quality_report` marks the run as blocked and sends the alert, if one is configured.

The rows that broke the rule in its latest evaluation are kept in `dq_audit.streaming_event_watch_seconds_valid`.

## Tested by

Scenario **`negative_watch_time`**: negative watch_seconds.

```bash
make generate DOMAIN=streaming SCENARIO=negative_watch_time BATCH=2026-10-20_negative_watch_time
make pipeline DOMAIN=streaming BATCH=2026-10-20_negative_watch_time
```
